DESCRIPTION: The Adamson Fletcher Machine over its own OSC (the AFM format): 64 objects' positions, levels, trajectories, jitter, rendering and sends, 8 groups, the reverbs, 8 aux sends, 12 layers, 16 VCAs, the master, snapshots and the binaural listener. The page names no port: give the one in its settings / OSC. Its ADM-OSC grammar is the adm-osc preset.

SOURCES: Adamson, Fletcher Machine manual v2, Quick start - OSC (manual version 2.0.261002, read 28/11/2026): https://adamson-fletcher-machine.com/manuals/v2/en/quickstart/osc - the OSC table and its four footnotes
